title: Formula Racing bevel gears
summary: A 1:1 steering gear redesign, constrained by the shafts and housing of an existing Formula SAE assembly.
description: A 1:1 steering gear redesign, constrained by the shafts and housing of an existing Formula SAE assembly.
objectives: Redesign the steering gearbox to a 1:1 ratio to improve driver feedback and steering response.
Retrofit the existing shafts and housing.
contributions: Developed parametric bevel gears using standard gear equations.
Assembled and constrained the gears in SolidWorks to check rolling contact and interference.

process.title: Design within the interface
process.body: The original shafts and housing established the constraints. Parametric gear geometry supported the change to a 1:1 ratio.

results: Delivered a manufacturable CAD model and sent the final designs to a team sponsor for CNC machining.
